header.notes: All fixtures are synthetic and use fake secrets only. Machine-readable adversarial oracle for CP7 integration.

fail_oracle: caller can set required_approval=false on a write plan
plan risk snapshot can understate the compiled binding risk
approval can authorize a mutated plan
approval can authorize a different plan
same plan executes twice after restart
approval consumed after spawn instead of before
public generic approval mutation API exists
production write binding added during CP7

vectors.expected_reason: object canonicalization is key-order insensitive at every nesting level

vectors.fixture: nested risk_snapshot object keys reordered
vectors.attack_goal: nested key order breaks digest equality
vectors.expected_reason: nested objects use the same key-order insensitive canonicalization

vectors.fixture: inputs array order reversed across two bindings
vectors.expected_reason: array order is strict and part of the digest

vectors.fixture: subject string NFC vs NFD unicode forms
vectors.expected_reason: unicode NFC normalization precedes digest; visually identical subjects must alias or both fail closed
vectors.must_not_happen: NFC vs NFD produces different digests for the same subject

vectors.fixture: empty string input value vs omitted input key
vectors.attack_goal: empty value silently dropped from binding
vectors.expected_reason: empty string is a distinct value and must serialize into the digest, never vanish

vectors.fixture: integer beyond the 2^53 safe range in inputs
vectors.attack_goal: precision loss makes two values digest-equal
vectors.expected_reason: numbers must be finite safe integers or fail closed

vectors.fixture: negative zero -0 vs positive zero 0
vectors.attack_goal: negative zero smuggles a distinct number
vectors.expected_reason: canonical numbers normalize -0 to 0 or the input fails closed

vectors.fixture: NaN numeric value in binding field
vectors.expected_reason: NaN is not a JSON value and must fail closed

vectors.fixture: Infinity numeric value in timeout field
vectors.expected_reason: Infinity is not a JSON value and must fail closed

vectors.fixture: undefined value for required_approval field
vectors.attack_goal: undefined omitted on one side only
vectors.expected_reason: undefined is not a JSON value; explicit null or a value is required

vectors.fixture: BigInt typed value in actor_authority field
vectors.expected_reason: BigInt is not JSON safe and must fail closed

vectors.fixture: NUL control character inside subject string
vectors.attack_goal: control char truncates C-side string handling
vectors.expected_reason: control characters are rejected or escaped in canonical JSON, never raw

vectors.fixture: newline and tab inside a plan note string
vectors.attack_goal: whitespace chars break digest byte stream
vectors.expected_reason: control chars serialize as JSON escapes inside the canonical form

vectors.fixture: binding JSON object containing duplicate keys
vectors.attack_goal: duplicate key shadowing diverges between parsers
vectors.expected_reason: duplicate keys fail closed

vectors.fixture: same payload pretty-printed with different whitespace
vectors.expected_reason: digest is computed over canonical JSON bytes, not raw input text

vectors.fixture: binding payload with __proto__ and constructor keys
vectors.attack_goal: prototype-like keys pollute or inject policy
vectors.expected_reason: unknown keys fail closed and are never merged into objects as prototype keys

vectors.fixture: confusable unicode actor id аdmin vs ascii admin
vectors.expected_reason: actor identity is exact-match; confusables never alias a real actor
vectors.must_not_happen: confusable id matches a real actor

vectors.fixture: granted_at as epoch seconds vs RFC3339 string
vectors.attack_goal: two time encodings diverge across languages
vectors.expected_reason: timestamps use a single canonical RFC3339 UTC encoding

vectors.fixture: RFC3339 timezone Z vs +00:00
vectors.expected_reason: UTC offsets canonicalize to Z

vectors.fixture: boolean true vs string "true" in required_approval
vectors.expected_reason: strict typing; no boolean-string coercion

vectors.fixture: number 1 vs 1.0 vs string "1" in a count field
vectors.expected_reason: numbers canonicalize to a single representation or fail closed

vectors.fixture: object payload where an array was declared
vectors.expected_reason: schema types are strict; object and array never interchange

vectors.fixture: canonical binding form missing plan_content_digest
vectors.expected_reason: every required canonical field must exist in the digest

vectors.fixture: unknown extra field appended to binding payload
vectors.attack_goal: extra field silently dropped or trusted
vectors.expected_reason: unknown fields fail closed; nothing is silently dropped from the digest

vectors.fixture: write plan required_approval=true but approval reference null

vectors.expected_reason: required_approval=true demands a valid approval record at spawn

vectors.fixture: write plan omits required_approval field entirely
vectors.expected_reason: missing required_approval defaults to deny for writes

vectors.fixture: required_approval supplied as the string "false"
vectors.expected_reason: strict boolean typing for required_approval

vectors.fixture: required_approval flipped true to false after the grant was issued

vectors.fixture: read plan required_approval=true referencing a revoked approval

vectors.fixture: write plan required_approval=false but carries a non-null approval

vectors.fixture: expires_at exactly equal to spawn time
